name: Periodic Financial Reporting Package
description: A periodic financial reporting package submitted by a borrower to a lender, containing operational performance, financial statements, and covenant compliance status.
key_questions: What is the Net Operating Income (NOI) for the reporting period?
What is the current Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR)?
Is the borrower currently in compliance with their financial covenants?
What are the reported total operating revenues and expenses?
